lines.zh: 我不走，我只是被挪了位置。
lines.en: I do not walk; I was merely moved.
My feet are fixed to the base.

lines.zh: 有人把我抬起来挪了两格。
lines.en: Someone lifted me two blocks over.
I sway and stop.

lines.zh: 我的关节是死的，不会迈步。
lines.en: My joints are dead and will not step.
I get pushed into a short slide.
This pose is the only one I have.

lines.zh: 我的紫色外壳在灯下动了一下。
lines.en: My purple shell shifts under the light.
I do not walk, but my shadow does.
I get carried to the other side of the display.
My base scrapes the floor.
I get dragged over, tilted.

lines.zh: 我立在展台上，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand on the display, motionless.
One of my ears is bent.
I hold the guitar without shifting.
My grin is stuck on my face.
A few patches of paint are gone.
I do not blink, and cannot.

lines.zh: 我的关节里没有一点声音。
lines.en: Not a sound comes from my joints.
The light slides off my shoulder.
I stand quieter than the wall.

lines.zh: 我等一场不会来的表演。
lines.en: I wait for a show that will not come.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣在吉他颈上。
lines.en: My fingers rest on the guitar neck.
My shadow rests on the wall.
My head tips slightly down.

lines.zh: 我保持着开场前的姿势。
lines.en: I hold the pose from before the show.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直朝着这个方向。
lines.en: My eyes have always faced this way.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，我什么都没做。
lines.en: You stand before me; I do nothing.
My grin shines a little in the light.
You are one block from me.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，也许没有。
lines.en: I have watched you a long time, perhaps.
My head cannot turn.
You raise a torch to my face.

lines.zh: 我的漆面反出一小块光。
lines.en: A small patch of light reflects off my paint.
There is no sound of breathing from me.
You wait for me to speak; I will not.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在你的影子里。
lines.en: My ear is inside your shadow.
You step back; I am still looking.

lines.zh: 我看不清你，我没有眼睛。
lines.en: I cannot see you; I have no real eyes.

lines.zh: 我的姿势让脖子有点歪。
lines.en: My pose sets my neck at an angle.
You have stopped moving too.
I smile at you, forever.
The lamp hums loudly.

lines.zh: 我的外壳被敲出一个坑。
lines.en: A dent is knocked into my shell.
I tip and my base rocks.
A patch of paint flakes off.

lines.zh: 我没有任何反应，只有响。
lines.en: I give no reaction, only a sound.
My ear folds down.
I cannot feel pain at all.
My guitar gets knocked askew.
I keep that expression.
I cannot hold anything.

lines.zh: 我的手指是画在吉他上的。
lines.en: My fingers are painted on the guitar.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我也没反应。
lines.en: You hold it high and I still do not react.
I cannot even open my mouth.
It sits at my feet and I do not look.
I have no stomach at all.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃它，光晃到我脸上。
lines.en: You wave it and the light flickers on my face.

lines.zh: 我的笑不会因为食物改变。
lines.en: My grin will not change for food.

lines.zh: 你撞到展台，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You hit the display and I sway.

lines.zh: 我整个人往后仰，又弹回。
lines.en: I tip back and spring upright.
My shell makes a hollow knock.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到我的吉他。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my guitar.
I shift half an inch on my base.
I get knocked toward the wall.
You steady me.
My ear bumps the frame.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一层塑料。
lines.en: A layer of plastic lies between us.
I sway, then go still.

lines.zh: 两个玩偶立在同一个展台。
lines.en: Two figures stand on the same display.
Our poses are almost identical.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵和它的耳朵挨着。
lines.en: My ear touches its ear.
We grin toward the door together.
They are arranged in a row.
My guitar leans on its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在墙上重合。
lines.en: Our shadows overlap on the wall.
A layer of dust lies between them.
We stand until the lights go out.

lines.zh: 我没有能拿起东西的手。
lines.en: I have no hands that can pick things up.

lines.zh: 它掉在我脚边，我捡不了。
lines.en: It falls at my feet and I cannot take it.
My fingers are fixed on the strings.
It leans against my base.
You tuck it into my arm.

lines.zh: 我的怀里多了一样东西。
lines.en: Something new is in my arms.

lines.zh: 它让我的轮廓变了一点。
lines.en: It changes my outline slightly.
I am still in the same pose.

lines.zh: 它慢慢滑下去，落在地上。
lines.en: It slides down and falls.

lines.zh: 你把东西从我的吉他上拿走。
lines.en: You take it off my guitar.
I could not be said to have a target.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不会对准任何人。
lines.en: My eyes will not aim at anyone.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，我没有动。
lines.en: You stand before me and I do not move.
I only stand and grin.
My head will not turn.
I have no legs to chase with.

lines.zh: 你越等越不安，我却没变。
lines.en: The longer you wait, the less easy you feel, and I am unchanged.
There is no switch on me.

lines.zh: 我的笑被你当成了意图。
lines.en: You read intent into my grin.
I do not choose prey.

lines.zh: 我只是展台上的一件东西。
lines.en: I am only an object on a display.
My fingers have never moved.

lines.zh: 你听见的只是灯的声音。
lines.en: What you hear is only the lamp.
Your shadow falls on my face.
I have no need to come near you.

lines.zh: 我正对着走廊，仅此而已。
lines.en: I face the corridor, that is all.

lines.zh: 我在你身后站着，一直如此。
lines.en: I stand behind you, as always.
You walked far and came back.
My position has not changed at all.

lines.zh: 你从侧面看我，我还是那样。
lines.en: You view me from the side and I am the same.

lines.zh: 我的笑在黑暗里也很清楚。
lines.en: My grin is clear even in the dark.

lines.zh: 你回头三次，我都没跟上。
lines.en: You look back thrice; I never follow.
I never chase; I only wait.
Your footsteps grow slower.

lines.zh: 我的影子长长地铺出去。
lines.en: My shadow stretches out long.

lines.zh: 你听见自己脚步的回声。
lines.en: You hear the echo of your own steps.
That thing on the display is still there.

lines.zh: 灯管一闪，我的脸亮了一下。
lines.en: The tube flickers and my face lights up.
You are not sure whether I moved.
I make no movement at all.

lines.zh: 你离开展厅时看了我一眼。
lines.en: You glance at me as you leave the hall.

lines.zh: 我一直在同一块地板上。
lines.en: I have always been on this same floor.
I keep you company until you leave.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在你的余光里。
lines.en: My ear sits in the corner of your eye.

lines.zh: 我抬不起手，只能被撞过来。
lines.en: I cannot raise a hand; I am merely knocked into you.
My shell hits your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，我被挤歪了。
lines.en: You squeeze past and I get shoved crooked.
My guitar bumps your back.
This is not a strike; it is my weight.
I tip into you and press on your leg.

lines.zh: 我的边角刮破你的袖子。
lines.en: My edge snags your sleeve.
You push me and I bounce back.

lines.zh: 我的底座磕到你的脚踝。
lines.en: My base knocks your ankle.
I have no strength at all.

lines.zh: 我晃得厉害，碰了你两下。
lines.en: I wobble and bump you twice.
My hard shell stops you.
My grin is right next to your face.
You hold me down, and I stop.
The contact is as light as dusting.
I do not move again.
A figure has appeared in the hall corner.

lines.zh: 我被摆在原来的位置上。
lines.en: I am set in my old place.

lines.zh: 灯下多了一张紫色的脸。
lines.en: A purple face appears under the light.
There was supposed to be one of me here.
A figure stands upright.

lines.zh: 它的底座碰到地板，响了一声。
lines.en: Its base hits the floor with a knock.
There is a faint moldy smell.
I did not come from anywhere.

lines.zh: 我被放在你必经的路上。
lines.en: I am placed on your only path.
The displays on this floor are full.

lines.zh: 我保持着被人摆好的角度。
lines.en: I hold the angle I was set at.

lines.zh: 灯忽然亮起来，我就在那。
lines.en: The lights come on and there I am.
I made no sound when I appeared.

lines.zh: 灰尘从我的肩上落下来。
lines.en: Dust falls from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我很久以前就在这里了。
lines.en: I have been here since long ago.

lines.zh: 你记得刚才这里没有东西。
lines.en: You recall there was nothing here.
My guitar shows first.

lines.zh: 塑料开始融化，滴了下来。
lines.en: My plastic begins to melt and drip.

lines.zh: 我从展台摔下，正面着地。
lines.en: I fall off the display face down.

lines.zh: 水进了我的壳里，我变重了。
lines.en: Water gets inside my shell and I grow heavy.
The blast flips me off my base.
An arrow sticks in my face, very visible.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的笑定住了。
lines.en: That force freezes my grin.
I never eat, and so never hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，灯光闪了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and the lights flicker.

lines.zh: 底座下面空了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The base is gone and I fall.
